3,148 likes, 36 comments - ca.jaydesai on August 18, 2026: "₹80 lakh car at an effective 5-year cost of just ₹16.5 lakh? 👀

For the MG M9 and MG Cyberster, depreciation can potentially translate into significant tax savings for business owners, along with EV running-cost and resale-value benefits.

And September 30, 2026 matters because the timing of purchase and putting the vehicle to use can impact depreciation benefits.

Luxury doesn’t always have to be just an expense—it can be a smarter financial decision too.".
